captions.detailed: This 3D model is a low-profile, ring-shaped pencil holder designed to support pencils at an angle. It features a conical outer wall that tapers inward towards the top, with a large open hole in the center. Encircling the top surface of the ring are thirteen evenly spaced, angled cylindrical holes designed to hold standard pencils so they lean inward and rest against each other.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hyperbolic pencil holder ring that arranges pencils in a circular array at an inward lean angle. The user should be able to customize parameters such as the number of pencils, pencil diameter, lean angle, base height, and wall width.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. The main body is a solid cylinder with a tapered profile defined by calculated radii based on the lean angle. A central core is removed using a slightly taller, translated cylinder. Finally, a for-loop rotates and translates angled cylinders around the ring to cut out the thirteen pencil holder slots.
